svg.title: P06: Functional core and steering queues collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: P06 Functional core and steering queues
Primitive · A² A1 · queue role collaboration
A run accepts steering or queued input while
A new steering message or input item is enqueued.
A transition core plus queued control messages and
The transition consumes or defers steering with
Steering messages have identity and a
Transition state changes only through the
Live input cannot mutate shared state
1 enqueue(message) → 2 admit(message) → 3 apply(steering) → 4 request(effect) → 5 return(result) → 6 consume(next)
Evidence: 26/41 repositories, 25/36 families; 26 trajectories (13 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: In-memory or durable inbox, priority, coalescing, and effect handlers.
Negative control: A mutable global message list without transition semantics is insufficient.
